identification.family_label: React LeagueList delete-button handler and league ID passing
identification.rationale: The earliest generated technical-content family appears in turn_000003, directly responding to turn_000002. Its single candidate is a React/TypeScript LeagueList modification intended to pass the league ID through modal and deletion click handlers. Later candidates are revisions or extensions in later responses and are excluded by the response-local boundary.

context.normalized_text: `LeagueList` maps over `data`, renders a delete button and conditionally renders a deletion modal inside every list item, while all items share the single `isModalOpen` state.
The modal’s confirm button calls `deleteLeague` with the `league.leagueId` belonging to the mapped item that rendered that modal.

evidence_spans: 문제는 여러개의 삭제 버튼 중 중간에 있는 버튼을 눌러도 항상 맨 마지막 버튼이 동작해서 엉뚱한 아이템이 삭제돼.
context.normalized_text: The user observes that clicking a middle delete button results in the last item’s deletion action being used, so the wrong item is deleted.
`deleteLeague` currently logs the supplied league ID, leaves the mutation commented out, and closes the modal.

specificity.normalized_text: The requested task is to explain why the last item’s deletion action is selected even when a middle delete button is clicked.
The user specifically asks whether event bubbling is the cause.
